ukm:Metadata.dc:title: The Universal Credit (Miscellaneous Amendments, Saving and Transitional Provision) Regulations 2018
ukm:Metadata.dc:publisher: King's Printer of Acts of Parliament
ukm:Metadata.dc:subject: SOCIAL SECURITY
ukm:Metadata.dc:description: Regulation 2 in these Regulations amends the Discretionary Financial Assistance Regulations 2001 (S.I. 2001/1167), regulation 3 amends the Universal Credit Regulations 2013 (S.I. 2013/376) (the “Universal Credit Regulations”), regulation 4 amends the Jobseeker’s Allowance Regulations 2013 (S.I. 2013/378) (the “Jobseeker’s Allowance Regulations”), regulation 5 amends the Universal Credit, Personal Independence Payment, Jobseeker’s Allowance and Employment and Support Allowance (Decisions and Appeals) Regulations 2013 (S.I. 2013/381) (the “Decisions and Appeals Regulations”), regulation 6 amends the Universal Credit (Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2014 (S.I. 2014/1230) (the “Transitional Regulations”) and regulation 7 amends the Universal Credit (Surpluses and Self-employed Losses) (Digital Service) Amendment Regulations 2015 (S.I. 2015/345) (the “Surplus Amendment Regulations”).
